title: Three Ideogram 4.0 image models added
summary:
Three Ideogram image options and a bridge for embedded apps arrived, while image-policy errors got clearer and the catalogs got a tidy-up.

Added paid text-to-image options `ideogram-v4-turbo`, `ideogram-v4-balanced`, and `ideogram-v4-quality`, and listed them in the image API docs. Requests map dimensions or aspect ratios to supported resolution presets; these models do not accept reference images or seeds.

The SDK can now coordinate with a trusted host for API access, top-level login, content height, and theme changes. Embedded sessions stay separate from standalone sessions. The shared account menu also defaults to “Connect” and holds its label on one line in narrow headers.

Safety-filter rejections from `qwen-image` and `qwen-image-plus` now return a 422 `content_policy_violation` with guidance to adjust the prompt, rather than appearing as server errors.

daily.title: Ideogram 4.0 Turbo
daily.text: Generate images from text with `ideogram-v4-turbo`, including square, landscape, and portrait resolution presets. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ideogram-v4-turbo).

daily.title: Ideogram 4.0 Balanced
daily.text: Generate images from text with `ideogram-v4-balanced` and choose an aspect ratio or dimensions that map to a supported preset. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ideogram-v4-balanced).

daily.title: Ideogram 4.0 Quality
daily.text: Generate images from text with `ideogram-v4-quality`, with square requests defaulting to 2048×2048. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ideogram-v4-quality).

daily.title: A bridge for embedded apps
daily.text: Apps using the SDK can accept API access from a trusted host, send login requests to it, report their height, and follow its light or dark theme. Embedded sessions remain separate from standalone app sessions. [Explore the React SDK & UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
